name: zeffect_handle_sample_ref_offset_event
description: zEffect::HandleSampleRefOffsetEvent plays a referenced sample either directly or at a node-derived world position plus event offset.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Functional coverage uses a DirectSound test buffer and does not exercise A3D provider calls for this effect event.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja reconstruction for 0x458e10 validates sample-ref lookup, non-positive nodeRefIndex simple playback, positive nodeRefIndex world-position lookup, event offset addition, PlayA3D dispatch, and constant return value 2.
The native smoke verifies the disabled-sound return path, the simple playback branch, and the offset branch by observing DirectSound playback counters and the resulting zSndPlayHandle world position.
